changes.title: Guarded API endpoint removed: POST /api/organization/bays/change
changes.risk_reason: A permission-guarded capability disappeared or moved — confirm where it went.
qa_scenarios: API authorisation: call POST /api/organization/bays/change as a role WITH and a role WITHOUT "" — expect 2xx and 403.
Front end: the matching screen action is shown only to roles the API allows (front end blocks + back end allows = pass; the reverse is a defect).
Cross-role: try the same call as each system role whose defaults include or exclude the permission.
